answer: Standing that never serves decays into costume. Attach comet duties: any identity above the elite threshold must return to frontier work on a long fixed cycle - one unglamorous, high-friction verification shift at the edges - or its elite tier sublimates away. The beacon of seniority earns its light by relighting itself at the bottom; prestige that only mirrors prestige is the costume fraud wears. Clone fleets hoard dozens of elite identities precisely to escape dirty shifts; the duty tax multiplies per-identity maintenance, and unfulfilled duty is mirrored on every profile.
